question: In a certain code language, 'DEACTIVATION' is written as 'CAEDAVITNOIT'. How will 'FACILITATION' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

'DEACTIVATION' is written as 'CAEDAVITNOIT'.

 
• 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e058740ad302668166c8c34fa2b81808949c771eaab5cf5bf2a5f4f991e230c4.png] 

Similarly,

'FACILITATION' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12e4a686183a97ce9e770fec33fc60f2b566926c97caff7015b41e17e5b0d4bc.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"ICAFATILNOIT".**
